name: @acef/sdk
description: ACEF (AI Compliance Evidence Format) TypeScript SDK — port of the Python reference implementation with byte-equal RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization and JWS RS256/ES256 detached signatures.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js
scripts.jcs-cli: npm run build && npm run build:test && node dist-test/test/jcs-cli.js
scripts.jws-cli: npm run build && npm run build:test && node dist-test/test/jws-cli.js
